evals.prompt: An owner supplies a repository export, deployment folder, schema dump, and logs.

expectations.text: Creates distinct identities, hashes, provenance, working-set separation, and sensitivity flags.

evals.prompt: Two exports share a filename but have different hashes and dates.

expectations.text: Keeps both and reports the discrepancy.
